title: Resolving the Gibbs Phenomenon in Fractional Fourier Series via Inverse Polynomial Reconstruction
summary: The fractional Fourier series generalizes the classical Fourier series by introducing a rotation angle $α$ in the time-frequency plane, but inherits the Gibbs phenomenon for piecewise smooth functions. Unlike the classical setting, the chirp modulation factor renders the fractional partial sum complex-valued, corrupting both real and imaginary components simultaneously and making direct adaptation of classical remedies insufficient.
